design_detail: One-off 0.9% contribution on net wealth of USD 1 million or more (Ley Orgánica de Solidaridad y de Corresponsabilidad Ciudadana, April 2016)
quote_original: También se establece el pago del 0,9% al patrimonio de las personas naturales con un patrimonio individual mayor a USD 1 millón
quote_en: It also sets a payment of 0.9% on the net wealth of individuals with individual wealth above USD 1 million
source_title: Proyecto tributario por el terremoto llegó a la Asamblea
grading_note: The same article says the bill was sent by President Correa as economic-urgent; the Assembly calls the law his initiative. Formal act (sponsorship) of a one-off levy on net wealth, although the bill was mostly an earthquake relief package.

design_detail: One-off 0.9% contribution on net wealth of USD 1 million or more
quote_original: la contribución del 0.9% sobre el patrimonio de las personas naturales que tengan patrimonios iguales o mayores a 1 millón de dólares será por una sola vez
quote_en: the 0.9% contribution on the net wealth of individuals with wealth of USD 1 million or more will be paid once only
source_title: Ley de Solidaridad y Corresponsabilidad tiene beneficios y contribuciones
grading_note: Assembly press note on the minister presenting the bill to the Comisión de Régimen Económico; the sentence is reported speech, so B rather than A.

design_detail: Approved the one-off 0.9% contribution on net wealth of USD 1 million or more (Ley de Solidaridad, Registro Oficial Suplemento 759, 20 May 2016)
quote_original: el pleno de la Asamblea Nacional aprobó con 94 votos
quote_en: the plenary of the National Assembly approved it with 94 votes
source_title: Ley Solidaria, iniciativa que beneficia a los afectados del 16A
grading_note: Formal adoption of a law that includes a one-off levy on net wealth; the vote date is taken from the law's Registro Oficial transmittal and is not on this page.

design_detail: Approved the report for first debate including the one-off 0.90% contribution on net wealth of USD 1 million or more
quote_original: La propuesta establece que las personas naturales que al 1 de enero de 2016 posean un patrimonio igual o mayor a un millón de dólares, pagarán la contribución del 0.90% por una sola vez.
quote_en: The proposal sets that individuals holding wealth of USD 1 million or more on 1 January 2016 will pay the 0.90% contribution once only.
source_title: Listo informe para primer debate de proyecto de Ley Solidaria por terremoto
grading_note: Same page: the committee approved the report with nine votes. Committee recommendation of a levy on net wealth.

design_detail: Temporary two-year contribution on net wealth of persons above USD 500,000 and of large companies (Ley de Creación de Oportunidades, later Ley Orgánica para el Desarrollo Económico y Sostenibilidad Fiscal)
quote_original: Yo seré uno de los ecuatorianos que más pagará impuestos con este proyecto de ley
quote_en: I will be one of the Ecuadorians who pays the most tax under this bill
source_title: Lasso: "Yo seré uno de los que más pagará impuestos con esta ley"
grading_note: The president presented his own bill to the Assembly; the same article describes its special contribution on persons with net wealth above USD 500,000. The bill also raised other taxes; the quote refers to the bill as a whole.

design_detail: Report for first debate keeping the temporary contribution on net wealth of persons above USD 1 million (and companies above USD 4 million)
quote_original: la contribución temporal la hagan empresas con patrimonio superior a los $ 4 millones y personas con un patrimonio superior a $1 millón
quote_en: the temporary contribution is to be paid by companies with wealth above USD 4 million and persons with wealth above USD 1 million
source_title: Reforma tributaria: La Asamblea propone cambios en la contribución temporal
grading_note: The committee raised the personal threshold from USD 500,000 and approved the report on 13 November 2021; it kept and reshaped the levy rather than dropping it.

design_detail: Permanent tax on the assets of the 270 economic groups: 2.25% to 3.50%, raising about USD 4 billion (2019 data)
quote_original: De tal manera que el impuesto a las grandes fortunas debe ser permanente.
quote_en: Hence the tax on large fortunes must be permanent.
source_title: Impuesto permanente a las Grandes Fortunas en Ecuador generaría más de USD 4 mil millones
publisher: Unidad de Análisis y Estudios de Coyuntura, Universidad Central del Ecuador
grading_note: Authored analysis recommending a permanent levy with rates; it taxes the assets of economic groups, which stand in for personal fortunes in the SRI data.

design_detail: Permanent direct tax on large fortunes and extraordinary profits
quote_original: El impuesto directo a las grandes fortunas y las utilidades extraordinarias, con el carácter de permanente, ha sido planteado por el FUT, la CONAIE, el Frente Popular
quote_en: The direct tax on large fortunes and extraordinary profits, on a permanent basis, has been proposed by the FUT, CONAIE, the Frente Popular
source_title: Ecuador: Impuestos a la riqueza y no a los salarios
grading_note: Column titled "taxes on wealth, not on wages", set against the government plan to levy wages; he presents the permanent fortunes tax as the alternative. B: named, no design.

design_detail: Tax on wealth and large estates, first of ten alternatives to raising VAT to 15%
quote_original: Creación de un impuesto a la riqueza y grandes patrimonios para que los sectores más ricos de la sociedad contribuirá al financiamiento del Estado
quote_en: Creation of a tax on wealth and large estates so that the richest sectors of society contribute to financing the State
source_title: Conaie propone diez alternativas al Gobierno de Daniel Noboa para no incrementar el IVA al 15 %
grading_note: Organisation's own list of alternatives, published on its X account on 5 February 2024; no rate or threshold.

design_detail: 5% on the patrimonio of the large economic groups, with a 1% tax on their assets (corporate groups, not individuals)
quote_original: Que suba el 5% al patrimonio de los grandes grupos económicos para recaudar más de USD 215 millones.
quote_en: That the tax on the wealth of the large economic groups be raised by 5% to raise more than USD 215 million.
source_title: Indígenas plantean medidas económicas alternas: impuestos para los ricos y reducción del IVA
grading_note: Proposal handed over with the Parlamento Popular after the October 2019 protests. Graded C: it taxes the wealth of company groups (corporate level), and "sube el 5%" is ambiguous between a rate and an increase.

design_detail: Permanent tax on persons with wealth of USD 1 million or more, estimated at USD 400 million; alternative to the VAT rise
quote_original: Un impuesto permanente para quienes tienen patrimonios de USD 1 millón o más.
quote_en: A permanent tax on those who hold wealth of USD 1 million or more.
source_title: Impuestos para la banca y no cerrar el ITT: las propuestas de asambleístas para no subir el IVA
grading_note: Reported list of the proposals he made in the first debate of the VAT bill; has a threshold and a revenue estimate. Reported speech.

design_detail: Tax on fortunes above USD 1 million, among four alternatives to the VAT increase
quote_original: un impuesto a las grandes fortunas que sobrepasen el millón de dólares
quote_en: a tax on large fortunes exceeding one million dollars
source_title: Las alternativas de la oposición en Ecuador para evitar el controvertido aumento del IVA de Noboa
grading_note: Bloc communiqué as reported; the date is the article's, the bloc's own text is not yet read (lead). Threshold given, so A.

design_detail: Special taxes on large estates above USD 1 million, among alternatives to the VAT rise to 15%
quote_original: impuestos especiales para los grandes patrimonios que superan el $ 1 millón
quote_en: special taxes on the large estates exceeding USD 1 million
source_title: Ley urgente para subir el IVA no suma apoyos en la Asamblea y bancadas de mayoría insisten en otras opciones
grading_note: Reported proposal in the first plenary debate (Pleno 893); threshold given. Reported speech.

design_detail: New tax on wealth above 1,000 minimum wages (SBU), excluding the main residence
quote_original: oferta crear un nuevo impuesto para los patrimonios superiores a 1.000 salarios mínimos vitales, excluyendo la residencia principal
quote_en: offers to create a new tax on estates above 1,000 minimum wages, excluding the main residence
source_title: Más o menos impuestos: las ofertas apuntan a una reforma tributaria
grading_note: Summary of his government plan for the February 2021 election; the date is the article's. The design (annual or one-off) is not stated; threshold given.

design_detail: Minority report: tax on fortunes above USD 1 million, with a higher ISD and levies on banks, pharmaceuticals and mining
quote_original: impuesto a las fortunas por encima de $ 1 millón
quote_en: tax on fortunes above USD 1 million
source_title: Ley urgente para subir el IVA no suma apoyos en la Asamblea y bancadas de mayoría insisten en otras opciones
grading_note: El Universo says he appealed in plenary to his minority report ("informe de minoría") with these proposals. Reported speech.

design_detail: Gradual tax on fortunes above USD 1 million starting at 0.5%, paid by about 2% of the population
quote_original: También proponen la aplicación de impuestos a las grandes fortunas sobre el millón de dólares; sería gradual y empezaría sobre 0,5%
quote_en: They also propose taxes on large fortunes above one million dollars; it would be gradual and start at 0.5%
source_title: Bancada oficialista analiza propuesta que exceptúa a sectores del incremento del IVA
grading_note: Names the bloc's alternative to the VAT rise, with rate and threshold. Reported by a regional paper; the bloc's own text is still a lead.
